rules.name: cs-05-root-cause-check-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT date_id, value_date, settlement_date FROM dbsystemuat.valuation_date_table
SELECT value_date, count(*) AS cache_rows FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_cfs GROUP BY value_date
SELECT business_unit, value_date, settlement_date, updated_timestamp FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT value_date, count(*) AS cache_rows, max(created_timestamp) AS built FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' GROUP BY value_date

SELECT 'deal_active_lots_table_cfs' AS input_table, count(*) AS row_count FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'security_settlement_value_table_cfs', count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'underlying_settle_value_table', count(*) FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE value_date = :valueDate

SELECT 'deal_active_lots_table' AS input_table, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'security_settlement_value_table', count(*) FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate UNION ALL SELECT 'underlying_settle_value_table', count(*) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate

SELECT trade_id, contract_number, product_code, currency, nc_factor, fx_nc_factor, curr_mult, mtm_nc, mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate AND contract_number LIKE 'ACM_CRD%' ORDER BY contract_number, trade_id LIMIT 50

SELECT DISTINCT m.currency, m.spot AS mapping_spot, u.underlying_id AS price_spot FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate) u ON lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(m.spot) AND u.underlying_id <> m.spot WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT p.curr_mult_factor AS product_value, u.underlying_id AS price_spot, count(*) AS products, min(p.invenio_product_code) AS example_product FROM opera.product_master_table p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :valueDate) u ON lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(p.curr_mult_factor) AND u.underlying_id <> p.curr_mult_factor GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT p.invenio_product_code, p.bbg_product_code, p.currency, p.curr_mult_type, p.curr_mult_factor, p.constant_curr_mult, p.constant_nc_factor, (SELECT max(u.settle_value) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant AND u.value_date = :valueDate AND u.underlying_id = p.curr_mult_factor) AS spot_exact, (SELECT max(u.settle_value) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant AND u.value_date = :valueDate AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(p.curr_mult_factor)) AS spot_any_case FROM opera.product_master_table p WHERE p.invenio_product_code = 'CM CRD'

SELECT p.invenio_product_code, p.bbg_product_code, p.currency, p.curr_mult_type, p.curr_mult_factor, p.constant_curr_mult, p.constant_nc_factor, (SELECT max(u.settle_value) FROM dbsystemuat.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.value_date = :valueDate AND u.underlying_id = p.curr_mult_factor) AS spot_on_date FROM dbsystemuat.product_master_table p WHERE p.invenio_product_code = 'CM CRD'

SELECT 'cache' AS place, c.trade_id, c.value_date, c.active_lots, c.derivative_type, c.mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.contract_number = 'MAO_W_303' UNION ALL SELECT 'lots', a.trade_id, a.value_date, a.active_lots, NULL, NULL FROM opera.deal_active_lots_table a WHERE a.tenant_id = :tenant AND a.business_unit = 'CFS' AND a.value_date = :valueDate AND a.trade_id IN (SELECT d.trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d WHERE d.tenant_id = :tenant AND d.business_unit = 'CFS' AND d.contract_number = 'MAO_W_303')

SELECT a.trade_id, a.value_date, a.active_lots, s.derivative_type, s.maturity_date FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT trade_id, security_id FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs WHERE contract_number = 'MAO_W_303') d ON d.trade_id = a.trade_id LEFT JOIN dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_cfs s ON s.security_id = d.security_id WHERE a.value_date = :valueDate
